➔ Client  : Citi Bank, USA 
Domain : Banking  
Program Title : AI & Fraud Prevention 
 
Led the enterprise -wide implementation  of AI-powered  fraud detection  and prevention capabilities 
across Citi Bank's digital payments ecosystem, leveraging machine learning models to identify 
suspicious  transactions  in real time. The initiative  focused on integrating  advanced  analytics  into the 
core banking and card platforms, enabling proactive fraud alerts, reducing false positives, and 
ensuring  compliance  with U.S. regulatory  requirements  for consumer  protection.  By delivering  these 
outcomes, the program strengthened transaction security, reduced fraud -related losses,  and 
enhanced customer trust in digital banking services.  
 
Roles & Responsibilities  – [As Program  Manager] 
• Strategic Program Execution : Directed the end -to-end lifecycle of integrating advanced 
machine  learning  models into the core banking  switch,  enabling  real-time identification  and 
blocking of suspicious transactions with a latency of under 200 milliseconds.  
• Fraud Loss Mitigation : Delivered a projected $15M+ in annual savings by  proactively 
detecting fraudulent patterns, significantly reducing chargebacks, operational charge -offs, 
and customer reimbursement liabilities.  
• Operational Efficiency & Customer Experience : Drove a 30% reduction in false positive 
alerts by optimizing ML model parameters and refining threshold rules, which minimized 
unnecessary transaction declines and reduced manual fraud analyst review workloads by 25%. 
• Regulatory Compliance : Ensured 100% adherence to U.S. consumer protection regulations 
(Regulation  E and Fair Credit Billing Act) by establishing  robust model validation  frameworks, 
audit trails, and transparent consumer alert protocols.  
• Cross-Functional Leadership : Orchestrated collaboration between Data Science, Core 
Engineering, Operations, and Legal/Compliance teams to align technical deliverables with 
business objectives, successfully delivering Phase 1 of the initiative 10% ahead of the 
projected timeline.  
• Stakeholder Governance : Acted as the primary liaison to Executive Steering Committees, 
translating  complex  model performance  metrics  (AUC-ROC, precision/recall)  into actionable 
business insights to secure continued funding and board approval for subsequent rollout 
phases. 
• Process Re -engineering: Redesigned legacy fraud escalation workflows to accommodate new 
AI-driven insights,  cutting  average  investigation  resolution  time by 40% and improving  overall 
case management efficiency.  
IMPACT  & RESULTS 
 
• $15M+ Annual Savings: Reduced  fraud-related  losses through  proactive  detection  and 
blocking of suspicious transactions.  
• 30% Reduction  in False Positives: Minimized  unnecessary  transaction  declines and improved 
customer experience through ML model optimization.  
• 40% Faster Investigations:  Accelerated  case resolution  through  redesigned  workflows  and AI-
driven insights.  
• 25% Reduction  in Analyst  Workload:  Decreased  manual review burden on fraud investigation 
teams. 
• 100% Regulatory  Compliance:  Achieved  flawless  adherence  to Reg E and FCBA with zero audit 
findings. 
• 10% Early Delivery:  Completed  Phase 1 ahead of schedule,  securing  board approval  for 
enterprise -wide expansion.  
• Sub-200ms Detection:  Enabled  real-time fraud identification  with near-instantaneous  
latency.

Domain : Banking

native practices. The program  enhanced scalability,  resilience,  and digital service  delivery  velocity 
while ensuring full compliance with PCI -DSS and U.S. financial regulations. Delivered measurable 
outcomes including 20% infrastructure cost reduction, 99.99% system uptime, and accelerated 
innovation in customer experience.

customer -facing applications  to hybrid cloud platforms,  establishing  a scalable,  future -ready 
architecture aligned with Citi's digital transformation roadmap.

success  KPIs, and risk mitigation  strategies —orchestrating  seamless  transition  of high-priority 
workloads while ensuring zero customer -impact downtime.

Engineering, Application Development, Security, and Compliance teams to  ensure secure,

99.99% system uptime.

infrastructure, containerization tools, and professional services, negotiating contracts and 
ensuring delivery against SLAs and program milestones.  
• Executive Stakeholder Engagement : Served as the primary liaison to Executive Steering 
Committees and  Board-level sponsors, translating technical migration metrics into clear 
business value propositions to secure continued funding and organizational buy -in. 
• Change Management & Adoption : Led organizational change initiatives to drive cloud -native 
adoption  across development  teams, implementing  CI/CD pipelines  and DevOps  practices  to 
accelerate feature releases and innovation cycles.  
PROGRAM  IMPACT  & RESULTS 
• 20% Infrastructure  Cost Reduction:  Modernized  legacy applications  through  containerization

• 99.99% System Uptime: Implemented  resilient  hybrid cloud architecture,  ensuring  near-
perfect availability for Citi's digital banking services.  
• Accelerated  Innovation:  Enabled  faster feature releases  and digital service  delivery  through

➔ Client  : Citi Bank, USA 
Domain : Banking  
Role : Project Manager

users by 5 million within 12 months, and achieve full compliance with PCI CP standards, network 
rules, and U.S. regulations (Reg E, Reg Z). By delivering these outcomes, the project sought to 
strengthen  payment security, enhance  customer  convenience, and  position Citi Bank as a leader  in 
digital payments innovation.

50M+ credit and debit card portfolio, modernizing the payment experience and accelerating 
digital adoption.

iterative progress across migration, integration, compliance, and feature enablement 
workstreams.  
• Collaborated  with cross-functional  squads (Payments,  IT Security,  Compliance,  Risk, Customer 
Experience, and Merchant Partnerships) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental 
features aligned with PCI CP standards and U.S. regulations (Reg E, Reg Z).  
• Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for universal tokenization, ensuring seamless 
provisioning  of cards into Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung  Pay, and merchant  platforms  such as 
Amazon and PayPal.  
• Oversaw  sprint-based technical  integration  with Visa Token Service (VTS) and Mastercard 
Digital Enablement  Service (MDES), ensuring  zero disruption  during migration  from legacy 
provisioning systems.  
• Partnered  with vendors  and internal  stakeholders  to validate  solution  design,  conduct  proof-of-
concept trials, and optimize system performance for large -scale tokenization and wallet 
adoption.

teams for supporting digital wallet transactions and dispute resolution processes.  
• Applied Agile metrics  (velocity,  burndown  charts,  defect tracking)  to monitor delivery  progress, 
identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.  
• Delivered measurable outcomes, increasing contactless transaction volume by 40%, growing 
active mobile wallet users by 5 million within 12 months,  and positioning  Citi Bank as a leader 
in secure, compliant digital payments.

➔ Client : Open Bank – Spain 
Domain  : Banking  
Role : Project  Manager 
 
The goal of the project at Openbank Spain was to implement and streamline cheque guarantee 
functionality  within the T24 Core Banking  system, ensuring  secure  handling  of high-value and sensi-
tive cheque transactions. The initiative  aimed to provide customers with certified cheques backed 
by the bank, thereby increasing trust and reliability in payments such as property down payments 
or large financial commitments. The project focused on enabling guarantee initiation, cancella -
tions, stop payments,  and handling  of non-presented  cheques  during  the validity  period,  with funds 
managed  securely  in suspense  accounts.  Ultimately,  the objective  was to enhance  transaction  secu-
rity, improve customer confidence, and align with Openbank Spain’s commitment to robust, com -
pliant, and efficient digital banking operations.

enabling  secure  initiation,  cancellation,  stop payments,  and non-payment  handling  of certi-
fied cheques.  
• Facilitated  Agile ceremonies  (daily stand -ups, sprint planning,  retrospectives)  to ensure it-
erative progress across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.  
• Collaborated  with cross-functional  squads (Core Banking,  Payments,  Compliance,  Risk, and 
Operations)  to prioritize  backlog  items and deliver incremental  enhancements  aligned with 
Openbank Spain’s regulatory and customer requirements.  
• Managed  sprint-based integration  activities,  ensuring  seamless  handling  of suspense  ac-
counts, guarantee validity periods, and customer account reconciliation.  
• Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct 
proof-of-concept  trials, and optimize  system  performance  for high-value cheque  transac -
tions. 
• Developed training and enablement materials  for operations  and customer  service  teams, 
ensuring  adoption  of new cheque  guarantee  processes  and compliance  with banking  stand-
ards. 
• Applied Agile metrics  (velocity,  burndown  charts,  defect tracking)  to monitor progress, 
identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.  
• Delivered  measurable  outcomes,  strengthening  transaction  security,  improving  customer 
trust in certified  cheques,  and aligning  with Openbank  Spain’s commitment  to robust and 
efficient digital banking operations.  
 
➔ Client : Open Bank – Spain 
Domain  : Banking  
Role : Project  Manager 
 
The goal of the project  was to enhance  Openbank  Spain’s T24 Core Banking system  to ensure com-
pliance with Spanish  Tax Authority  regulations  governing  joint accounts  and deposits.  Specifically, 
the system needed to validate that all beneficial owners of a joint account or deposit share the 
same residential status —either all residents of Spain or all non -residents. The initiative aimed to  
prevent the creation of joint accounts with mixed residency status, enforce accurate validations 
during account opening, and provide clear error messaging when rules were violated. By imple -
menting these controls, the project sought to strengthen regulatory compliance, improve opera -
tional accuracy,  and safeguard  customer  trust in Openbank  Spain’s account  management  processes.  
 
Roles & Responsibilities:  - [As Project  Manager] 
• Led Agile delivery  of compliance  enhancements  in the T24 Core Banking system to enforce 
Spanish Tax Authority rules on joint accounts and deposits.  
• Facilitated  Agile ceremonies  (daily stand-ups, sprint planning,  retrospectives)  to drive iter-
ative progress across requirement validation, system design, development, and testing.  
• Collaborated  with cross-functional  squads (Core Banking,  Compliance,  Risk, IT, and Opera-
tions) to prioritize backlog items and ensure regulatory alignment.  
• Defined  user stories  and acceptance  criteria for residency  validation,  ensuring  the system 
correctly restricted joint accounts to either all residents or all non -residents.  
• Managed  sprint-based system  integration  and testing activities,  validating  error messages 
and exception handling for mixed residency scenarios.  
• Partnered  with stakeholders  and vendors  to ensure  solution  design adhered  to compliance 
standards and operational workflows.  
• Developed  training  and enablement  materials  for branch and operations  staff to ensure 
smooth adoption of new account validation processes.  
• Applied Agile metrics  (velocity,  burndown  charts,  defect tracking)  to monitor delivery  pro-
gress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues.  
• Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening regulatory compliance, improving opera -
tional accuracy,  and safeguarding  customer  trust in Openbank  Spain’s account  management 
processes.

➔ Client : Bank International  Luxembourg 
Domain  : Banking  
Role : Project  Manager

compliance  processes  within Bank International  Luxembourg’s  core banking systems,  ensuring  accu-
rate deduction  and reporting  of tax on customer  deposit  interest.  The initiative  aimed to automate 
the calculation  and withholding  of DIRT at the statutory  rate of 41% before interest  payments  were 
credited to customers, while also enabling mandatory reporting to the Revenue authorities when 
annual interest exceeded predefined thresholds. By embedding these controls, the project sought

obligations, and safeguard the bank’s adherence to income tax and reporting standards.

ative progress across requirement gathering, system design, development, and testing.  
• Collaborated  with cross-functional  squads  (Tax Compliance,  Core Banking,  IT, Risk, and Op-
erations) to prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental features aligned with regula -
tory mandates.  
• Defined  user stories  and acceptance  criteria  for automated  DIRT calculation  at 41%, with-
holding before interest payments, and mandatory reporting to Revenue when thresholds 
were exceeded.  
• Managed  sprint-based integration  activities,  ensuring  seamless  reconciliation  between  cus-
tomer accounts, tax reporting modules, and regulatory systems.  
• Partnered  with vendors and internal  stakeholders  to validate  solution  design,  conduct 
proof-of-concept trials, and optimize system performance for tax compliance.  
• Developed  training  and enablement  materials  for operations  and customer  service  teams to

• Applied Agile metrics  (velocity,  burndown  charts,  defect tracking)  to monitor delivery  pro-
gress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.  
• Delivered measurable outcomes, reducing manual overhead, ensuring regulatory compli -
ance, improving  transparency  in customer  tax obligations,  and safeguarding  Bank Interna -
tional Luxembourg’s adherence to reporting standards.  
 
➔ Client : Nordea – Finland 
Domain  : Banking  
Role : Project  Manager 
 
The goal of the project was to enable 24/7 loan applications, top -ups, and disbursement requests 
across Nordea Finland’s digital channels (mobile, internet banking, and  call center) while  ensuring 
compliance with Finnish Consumer  Rights legislation. The  initiative focused on  embedding business 
rules into the core banking system to enforce the legal requirement that any loan approved be -
tween 23:00 EET  and 07:00 EET must be deferred  until 07:00 EET the following  day. By implement -
ing these controls,  the project  sought to deliver a seamless  customer  experience,  ensure regulatory 
compliance, and strengthen operational efficiency in loan servicing.  
 
Roles & Responsibilities:  - [As Project  Manager] 
• Led Agile delivery  of loan application,  top-up, and disbursement  functionality  across Nordea 
Finland’s digital channels (mobile, internet banking, and  call center), ensuring compliance 
with Finnish Consumer Rights legislation.  
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand -ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) to drive 
iterative  progress  across requirement  gathering,  system  design,  development,  and testing.  
• Collaborated with cross -functional squads (Core Banking, Compliance, Risk, IT, and 
Operations)  to prioritize  backlog  items and deliver incremental  features aligned  with 
regulatory mandates.  
• Defined  user stories  and acceptance  criteria  to enforce  business  rules requiring  deferred 
disbursement of loans approved between 23:00 EET and 07:00 EET until 07:00 EET the 
following day.  
• Managed  sprint-based integration  activities,  ensuring  seamless  processing  across loan 
origination, approval,  and disbursement  modules while maintaining  compliance  with 
consumer protection laws.  
• Partnered  with stakeholders  and vendors  to validate  solution  design, conduct  proof-of-
concept trials, and optimize system performance for 24/7 loan servicing.  
• Developed  training  and enablement  materials  for customer  service and operations  teams to 
ensure smooth adoption of new loan disbursement processes.  
• Applied  Agile metrics  (velocity,  burndown  charts, defect tracking)  to monitor delivery 
progress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.  
• Delivered  measurable  outcomes,  enabling  24/7 loan servicing,  ensuring  compliance  with 
Finnish legislation, and enhancing customer trust in Nordea Finland’s digital banking 
services.
